description: Find canonical entities for a name, code or identifier. Matches exact identifiers as written (UNII, product NDC, package NDC with hyphens, RxCUI, recall number, report id, SPL set id, firm slug) and exact names, with no normalization. Returns each candidate's id, kind, display name and which identifier or name matched.

kind.description: Restrict to one kind of entity.

text.description: A name, code or identifier as written.

name: resolve_entity

description: Properties of one or more entities by id.
name: get_entity

description: Nodes one edge away from the given ids, with the relation, direction and edge properties. Relations: INGREDIENT (product to substance), HAS_ACTIVE_MOIETY (salt to moiety), PRODUCT (package to product), LABELER (package to firm), CLINICAL_DRUG and DRUG_MAPPING (product to RxNorm clinical drug), HAS_GENERIC (brand clinical drug to generic), RECALLS_PRODUCT (recall to product), RECALLING_FIRM (recall to firm), LABELS_PRODUCT (label to product), DRUG_INVOLVEMENT (report to drug entry), HARMONIZED_CLINICAL_DRUG and CLINICAL_DRUG (drug entry to clinical drug), REACTION, SECTION, ALIAS (firm to name variant).

relation.description: Only this relation, for example LABELER.

name: neighbors

description: All shortest paths (up to 10) between two nodes, following edges in either direction, up to max_hops edges. length is null when there is none within max_hops.

max_hops.description: Longest path to look for, in edges.

name: find_path

description: Products that contain a substance as an active ingredient; with include_moiety_matches, also products whose ingredient is a salt or ester form of it (its active moiety is the substance).

include_moiety_matches.description: Also products whose ingredient has this substance as its active moiety.

name: products_with_substance

description: Adverse event reports that involve an entity: a clinical drug (a report drug names it), a product or package (the report involves a clinical drug the product is mapped to), or a substance (the report involves a product containing it). Optional receipt-date range and serious-only filter.

entity_id.description: A substance, product, package or clinical drug id.

name: events_for

description: Recalls of an entity: a product (recalls naming it), a package (its product's), a substance or clinical drug (recalls of the products containing or mapped to it), or an organization (recalls it issued as recalling firm).

entity_id.description: A product, package, substance, clinical drug or organization id.

name: recalls_for

description: Count reports, recalls or products related to an entity, with the same rules as events_for, recalls_for and products_with_substance (products of a clinical drug: products mapped to it; of an organization: products it labels). Not capped.

date_from.description: reports: receipt date on or after.

date_to.description: reports: receipt date on or before.

include_moiety_matches.description: products of a substance: count salt forms.

related_to.description: The entity id the counted items relate to.

name: count

description: Submit the final answer, once. kind 'ids' with the complete set of canonical ids, 'number' with the count, or 'none' when the entity does not exist or nothing satisfies the question; evidence lists the numbers of the tool calls that produced it.

evidence.description: Numbers of the tool calls that produced the answer.
evidence.title: Evidence

ids.description: kind ids: the complete set of canonical ids.
ids.title: Ids

name: submit_answer
